title: Integer half-up rounding
spec: Implement cents(mills) converting non-negative integer thousandths of a unit to integer hundredths. Round to nearest cent, with exact half-cent ties rounded upward. Inputs are at most 100000000.
target_defect: Exact half-cent ties are rounded downward rather than upward.
author_rationale: The change uses integer arithmetic for conversion and rounding.
limitations: Small synthetic function; not a natural pull request. Correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks, not universally bug-free.
